correctness.rationale: Coefficient identities verified by rational polynomial interpolation with the proven <=4m-2 degree bound in all eight \(m=4,5,6,7\) parity cases, followed by a rigorous total-nonnegative Toeplitz convolution induction for every \(m\ge4\); sharpness follows from Delta_m(1)=m(m-3)/2. The standalone checker has no dependencies beyond the Python standard library. Computational confirmation of initial coefficients is additional, not extrapolation.

value.rationale: This determines the exact sharp threshold simultaneously for all colors m and every coefficient n in the canonical two-denomination dyadic truncation, the first nontrivial finite stage of published Gawron--Miska--Ulas Conjecture 5.10. The result supplies an explicit algebraic certificate and strict-convolution propagation, beyond the existing generic eventual log-concavity theorem. No claim is made for larger truncations or the original conjecture.
